en.headline: Hong Kong man returned to Philippine prison after weather delays deportation
en.dek: Tang Lung-wai was taken back to maximum-security jail when a typhoon suspended immigration offices, his lawyer said, calling the delay illegal detention.
body: A Hong Kong man whose Philippine prison sentence was ruled complete has been returned to a maximum-security facility after severe weather halted his deportation, his lawyer said.

Tang Lung-wai’s Philippine counsel Blessie Rose Carpena told the South China Morning Post that prison authorities escorted him to the Bureau of Immigration last Friday. Government offices were suspended because of a passing typhoon, so he was taken back to New Bilibid Prison in Muntinlupa.

Carpena said the Bureau of Immigration’s delay could constitute illegal detention and described Tang as frustrated and devastated. A Manila court in late July ruled that, after good-conduct time allowances, his sentence was fully served and ordered immediate release and deportation.

Tang was arrested in the Philippines in July 2000 for possession of methamphetamine and sentenced in 2011 to 40 years. He has maintained his innocence throughout more than two decades of imprisonment.

zh.headline: 港人鄧龍威菲國刑滿後因風球延誤遭送回監獄
zh.dek: 律師指颱風令入境部門暫停辦公，鄧龍威被送回最高設防監獄，並形容延誤屬非法羈留。
body: 一名已被裁定刑期屆滿的香港男子，因惡劣天氣延誤遣返程序而被送回菲律賓最高設防監獄，其律師表示。
鄧龍威的菲律賓律師Blessie Rose Carpena向《南華早報》表示，上周五監獄當局將他送往移民局，但因颱風導致政府部門暫停辦公，他被送回位於門特路帕的新比里必監獄。
律師指移民局延誤釋放或構成非法羈留，並形容鄧龍威感到沮喪及震驚。馬尼拉一法院於7月底裁定，計及良好行為扣減刑期後，他已服滿刑期，並下令即時釋放及遣返。
鄧龍威於2000年7月在菲律賓因藏有冰毒被捕，2011年被判囚40年。他一直堅稱無辜，至今已囚超過20年。
